content:
### Music

While 2025 may not have delivered a wave of huge pop culture moments like its predecessor, it was still a strong year for music streaming. Major global artists continued to dominate, while K-Pop, Country and Pop music soared. Meanwhile, Spotify was there to help you listen along all year round.

#### Most-Streamed Artists Globally in 2025

Bad Bunny is Spotify’s 2025 Global Top Artist, with more than 19.8 billion streams. He reclaims the top spot for the fourth time, after previously being the most-streamed artist in 2020, 2021, and 2022. He’s followed by Taylor Swift (#2), The Weeknd (#3), Drake (#4), and Billie Eilish (#5).

To mark Bad Bunny’s achievement, Spotify is celebrating with fan experiences, a global film launch, on-platform easter eggs, and more. [...] Here’s the Global Top 10 Artists of 2025:

1. Bad Bunny
2. Taylor Swift
3. The Weeknd
4. Drake
5. Billie Eilish
6. Kendrick Lamar
7. Bruno Mars
8. Ariana Grande
9. Arijit Singh
10. Fuerza Regida

Lady Gaga and Bruno Mars’s “Die With A Smile” claims 2025’s top spot, with more than 1.7 billion streams globally in 2025 alone. title: The Top Artists, Songs, Albums, Podcasts, and Audiobooks of 2025
content:
## Bad Bunny is once again Spotify’s Global Top Artist

For the fourth time, after claiming the title in 2020, 2021, and 2022, our users have crowned Bad Bunny Spotify’s top artist globally, with 19.8 billion streams this year. He also clinched the global top album of 2025 with DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS. To celebrate this achievement, Spotify is launching a global campaign honoring the superstar and his fans, including a short film, Leap Year, unique fan activations around the globe, and on-platform surprises.

Rounding out the top five artists are Taylor Swift in second place (but first in the U.S.), followed by The Weeknd (third), Drake (fourth), and Billie Eilish (fifth).

## The trends that shaped our year

### Music [...] On the global albums list, Bad Bunny’s DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS came out on top this year. But the influence of the screen was also undeniable, as KPop Demon Hunters (Soundtrack from the Netflix Film) captured the number-two spot. And showing the staying power of a blockbuster release, Billie Eilish’s HIT ME HARD AND SOFT and Sabrina Carpenter’s Short n’ Sweet both returned to the top five for the second year in a row.

### Podcasts

For the sixth consecutive year, The Joe Rogan Experience was Spotify’s top podcast globally, followed by The Diary Of A CEO with Steven Bartlett and The Mel Robbins Podcast in second and third place, respectively. [...] ## The trends that shaped our year

### Music

This year’s most-streamed music tells a story of both superstar collaborations and enduring fan favorites. Lady Gaga and Bruno Mars’ smash hit “Die With A Smile” took the title of top song globally with over 1.7 billion streams, while ROSÉ and Bruno Mars captured the number-three spot with “APT.” Billie Eilish’s “BIRDS OF A FEATHER” climbed from number three in 2024 to the number-two spot this year, showing its lasting appeal.

title: Spotify Most-Streamed Artists of 2025 - ChartMasters
content:
Usual suspects from Canada, The Weeknd and Drake, rank at #3 and #4, respectively, both down one spot from last year. This means 2025 is the fourth year in a row in which the same quartet has exchanged positions in the top 4 spots.

Billie Eilish and Ariana Grande confirmed their magnificent 2024 year, repeating positions at #5 and #6. The former topped 10 billion streams this year, the second time in a row.

Arijit Singh makes history, becoming the first Indian artist to claim a top 10 position thanks to nearly 9 billion streams. [...] ### 29 (37) Ed Sheeran – 6.00 billion streams

Just as we thought he had run out of gas, Ed Sheeran recovers a bit in 2025, increasing his streams from exactly 5.00 billion to exactly 6.00 billion. His new album Play, while nowhere near the heights of Multiply or Divide, is days away from surpassing Subtract and clearing the billion mark. Both singles Azizam and Sapphire have been able to gain some traction, with the latter unexpectedly hitting #1 in India.

On the more negative side, he dropped out of the top 5 most-streamed artists ever list, in Ariana Grande‘s favor. Justin Bieber, Eminem, and Billie Eilish are coming after him, too. The one who felt like the king of streaming in the past may drop out of the top 10 entirely in the upcoming years without a dynamic shift. [...] At the start of 2026, she has six songs charting on Spotify’s top 200 – more than Taylor Swift, Tate McRae, Billie Eilish (3 each), Sabrina Carpenter (4), and Olivia Dean (5). With a cut just over a million to feature on this ranking, Rihanna actually has 11 songs pacing at 850,000 streams or more. This includes her strongest current hit, the ever-viral Breakin’ Dishes, and Wale‘s Bad remix, a 2013 song that is enjoying a second (first?) life.

# List of most-streamed artists on Spotify

![Page semi-protected](//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/1/1b/Semi-protection-shackle.svg/20px-Semi-protection-shackle.svg.png)![](//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/4e/Taylor_Swift_at_the_2023_MTV_Video_Music_Awards_%281%29.png/250px-Taylor_Swift_at_the_2023_MTV_Video_Music_Awards_%281%29.png)

The following list contains the most-streamed artists on the [audio streaming](/wiki/Streaming_media "Streaming media") platform [Spotify](/wiki/Spotify "Spotify"). As of April 2026, [Taylor Swift](/wiki/Taylor_Swift "Taylor Swift") is the most-streamed artist in Spotify's history. [Bad Bunny](/wiki/Bad_Bunny "Bad Bunny") is the most-streamed male artist.[[1]](#cite_note-Millman-2026-1)

Since 2013, Spotify has published a yearly list of its most-streamed artists, which has been topped by Bad Bunny a record four times (2020–2022; 2025), being the only artist to do so in three consecutive years. [Drake](/wiki/Drake_(musician) "Drake (musician)") has topped the list three times (2015–2016; 2018), while Swift is the only female artist to have topped the list (2023–2024).
